description: Use after search_live_jobs when the person picks one of the results to apply to. The same as apply_to_public_job, for a pool_job_id: puts the job into the person's matches and starts the application for that ONE job, which SUBMITS in the person's name. Needs the saved CV, a confirmed email and an active plan. Confirm with the person first. dry_run=true prepares and sends nothing.
name: apply_to_live_job
title: Apply to a job found by search
